author: AlvaroMorata
body:
I am a holding midfielder, looking a clan to compete in the tourneys.. I have been in two clans..
Atomic Warriors ((Left due to unorganization)
SaberCross (I wanted a change)

I took a long break from clans the first time I left SaberCross, it was because I felt really bad inside for making enemies over the internet in a game called minecraft. I then came back and started competing in scrims (we didn't do too bad) I enjoyed it for a while... I then came to my last scrim with SaberCross where it ended there for me... After the scrim the guys started fighting, and that was the main reason I left the first time, I immediately after the scrim left. It was hard but I think it's worth it now that I think about it. I feel so much better and I am ready to come back. 

Enough with the story.

I am looking for a clan who is friendly, and can compete at a high level.. I don't want to be at a clan who will "omg rekt ezpz" all the flipin time.

Pros:
 I would say I am good with the sword.
Vision - meaning I see who is around the map, and not concentrate on one player.
Smart player - I am not the player who just rushes in and hope for the best, I am very Tactical.
Leader on the field - I would be able to handle tough situations..
Communication -  I am also very good with talking with people. :L I know..
Chemistry: I can always find that player who I play well next to..                                                                         

Cons:
I am not the best at rushing.
I don't use my bow when I am meant to be using it.
I can get mad at times..

If this doesn't go as planned, I might as well quit clans for good.
